name: Kanzaki Yuu
source:
"Kanzaki Yuu. He's a huge fan of idols... Not that I have a problem with that... But if he could tone it down a little, that would be nice..."

The protagonist's classmate and best friend. A huge idol otaku who often tries dragging the protagonist along to idol shows.
